title: Wire /activation/read into the production daemon: the Activate card can actually read its receipts
description:
SPUN-OUT PREREQUISITE. Parent: task-bb844c288fb346c0856778c738b9f073 ("Activate a fresh project from the browser"). Filed by worker-75411639 on 2026-09-05 from task-ac9d5e2d43334525bd990b1362652ce4 (child D, the proof/hardening row), which is BLOCKED on this. CONSUMER: task-ac9d5e2d43334525bd990b1362652ce4.

THE GAP, MEASURED AT branch moe/work-2026-09-04 HEAD 818174f7 (merge-base main 68eb1c5d).

Child C (task-0a5d7212, DONE) shipped apps/daemon/src/http/activation-read.ts — the route, the handler, the read-only ports, the listener option FIELD, the dispatch branch, the guards, the dev-proxy allowlist entry. Child C2 (task-3506e04a, DONE) shipped the browser reader and the Activate card. NOTHING CONSTRUCTS THE PORT.

`grep -rn "createActivationReadPort" --include=*.ts apps/ packages/ | grep -v '\.test\.'` returns exactly ONE line: its own definition at apps/daemon/src/http/activation-read.ts:182. daemon-entry.ts:263-311 spreads 25 optional listener deps into startControlRoomListener and `activation` is not among them, so `StartListenerOptions.activation` (http-listener.ts:145) is permanently undefined and handleActivationReadRequest (activation-read.ts:236-237) always takes the `port === undefined` branch.

LIVE PROOF against the real production boot (`daemon-main.ts --dependencies=apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.ts --port=0`, headers copied from apps/control-room/src/live/live-config.ts:94-99). Full probe source is inline in the comment worker-75411639 left on task-0a5d7212:
  POST /activation/read  -> HTTP 503 {"code":"LISTENER_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE","layer":"CONTROL_ROOM_LISTENER"}
  POST /affordances/read -> HTTP 200 {"nextAllowedCommands":[policy.install, project.register, session.open],"outcome":"SURFACE",...}
The command/surface plane the chain drives is HEALTHY. Only the receipts read is unwired.

WHY IT MATTERS: live-activation.ts decodes that exact 2-key body via `exactDataRecord(response,["code","layer"])` into `{status:"REFUSED"}`, and ActivateScreen (apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activation-screen.tsx:113-124) EARLY-RETURNS whenever `outcome.status !== "ACTIVATION"`, rendering only `cr.activate.refusal`. `cr.activate.button` is never mounted. So at HEAD no operator can drive project.register -> project.bind_repository -> provider.probe -> project.activate from the browser, and the whole parent feature is dark in production while every unit suite is green.

THE INPUTS ALREADY EXIST — this is a wiring row, not a design row.
- `activationReceiptInput(projectId, env = process.env, cwd = process.cwd())` is exported at apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-command-entry.ts:66 and is already consumed by apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-registry.ts:40 for the command path. Reuse it; do not mint a second input builder.
- `createActivationReadPort({ input, measure?, ports? })` (activation-read.ts:182) already applies `readOnlyActivationPorts`, so the read creates no `<projectRoot>/.moe-next/backups/` directory and reports `backup` as ACTIVATION_READ_BACKUP_DEFERRED under the route's own layer. Do not re-neuter anything.
- MEASUREMENT MUST STAY PER-REQUEST. activation-command-entry.ts:86-89 states why: a set captured at boot would certify a tree the operator has since changed. `createActivationReadPort.readActivation` already measures on every call, so constructing the PORT once at boot is correct — but do not add a response cache.
- The port carries `boundProjectId` and the handler refuses ACTIVATION_READ_PROJECT_MISMATCH when the authenticated principal's projectId differs, so the port must be built with the daemon's own configured projectId, never a request-supplied one.

The dev proxy is NOT part of this gap: apps/control-room/src/live/dev-proxy-paths.ts:6 already carries "/activation/read".

NOT IN SCOPE: changing the measurer, the receipt vocabulary, the card, or the browser reader. Those landed and are graded on their own rows.
definitionOfDone: A real production daemon boot (`daemon-main.ts --dependencies=apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.ts`) answers POST /activation/read with HTTP 200 and `outcome: "ACTIVATION"`, carrying all six members in ACTIVATION_RECEIPT_MEMBERS order plus the `signing` row with `trustBoundary: false`. Evidence: the probe transcript quoted verbatim, and the probe's full source inline in the completion record (global rail 12) OR a committed test arm that survives the commit.

`grep -rn "createActivationReadPort" --include=*.ts apps/ packages/ | grep -v '\.test\.'` returns at least one PRODUCTION call site at the delivered tree, and `grep -n "activation" apps/daemon/src/daemon-entry.ts` shows the listener spread carrying it. A test pins the wiring at the boot seam — not merely that the function exists.

The read still WRITES NOTHING: after N>=3 reads against a scratch project root, `<projectRoot>/.moe-next/backups/` does not exist, and the `backup` member reads code ACTIVATION_READ_BACKUP_DEFERRED at layer ACTIVATION_READ. Asserted, with the exact code, not merely 'no crash'.

The refusal paths keep their stable codes and the layer that answered: a principal without CAPABILITIES.ADMIN gets ACTIVATION_READ_CAPABILITY_DENIED; a principal bound to another project gets ACTIVATION_READ_PROJECT_MISMATCH; a non-empty body gets LISTENER_ACTIVATION_REQUEST_INVALID; a throwing measurement gets ACTIVATION_READ_UNREADABLE. Each verified by mutating the production surface and confirming the arm goes red (global rail 1).

Credential scrubbing still holds at the wired seam: `secretValues` is applied to every `reason` and `ref` the wired port publishes, proven by a canary that plants a held credential value into a measurement reason and asserts `[redacted]` on the wire — the defect child C found must not regress when the port is constructed from a different call site.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines (global rail 8, never the exit code): `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (label it 'root lane only, apps/** not covered'). Repo-wide legs graded as a path-attributed baseline (global rail 3): merge-base failures, HEAD failures, and the delta intersected with owned paths, with any foreign red disclosed verbatim.
taskRails: MEASUREMENT STAYS PER-REQUEST. Construct the port once at boot if you like — `readActivation` measures on every call — but never cache the RESULT. activation-command-entry.ts:86-89 states the rule: a set captured at boot certifies a tree the operator has since changed.

REUSE `activationReceiptInput` (activation-command-entry.ts:66). A second input builder is a second place for MOE_PROJECT_ROOT / MOE_STORE_PATH / MOE_AGENT_COMMAND semantics to live, and the measurer already owns what an absent variable means.
THE READ NEVER WRITES. `readOnlyActivationPorts` neuters exactly `backup` and `fs.mkdir`; leave `exists`, `stat` and `readBytes` REAL or four members silently degrade to unmeasured.

This is a WIRING row. Do not change the measurer, the receipt vocabulary, the browser reader or the Activate card — those landed on task-741dad13, task-0a5d7212 and task-3506e04a and are graded there.

A DIAGNOSIS I MADE AND CORRECTED, recorded because it changes how the committed test is written: my first probe left MOE_PROJECT_ROOT pointing at a directory that was never created, and repository/distribution came back `reason: "Error: spawn git ENOENT"`.
